senses.definition: adj. perhaps singing, sweetly sounding, musical;—abs. כִּנּוֹר נ׳ ψ 81:3 sweetly-sounding lyre; cstr., as subst., נְעִים זְמִרוֹת יִשׂ׳ 2 S 23:1 Israel’s sweet singer of songs (cf. Dr 2 S 8:10 Löhr; 𝔙 egregius psaltes Israel, and so Ges Ew al., from I. נעם; joy of the songs of Isr. HPS, cf. Klo Kit).
